text:
maria: Starting thread — proposal for a Metric Delta Explorer in the rollout dashboard.

maria: Problem: current canary view only shows raw time-series. We need computed deltas (canary vs baseline), sample sizes, and per-segment drilldowns.
aj: +1. Also need automatic guards that can block traffic splits when regressions exceed thresholds :warning:
kevin: Can we support both pct and absolute diffs? latency pct change vs raw ms matters at low latency.
sanjay: yes. propose model: report {metric, baseline, canary, delta_abs, delta_pct, samples}
kevin: sketch config for guard:
```
{
  "guard": {
    "metric": "p95_latency_ms",
    "delta_pct_threshold": 12,
    "window": "5m",
    "min_samples": 200,
    "action": "auto-fallback"
  }
}
```
aj: UI notes: show small diff sparkline next to metric card + a colored pill (green/yellow/red) and a link "drill" that expands segment breakdown (region, model variant, route path).
zara: telemetry cost question — computing per-segment deltas across thousands of routes might explode cardinality.
maria: agree. plan: pre-aggregate at route+region+model granularity and only sample segments above a usage threshold. Also allow on-demand rollups for drilldowns.
sanjay: we should compute statistical significance to avoid noisy alerts. e.g., use t-test or Bayesian credible intervals, and only fire guards if p<0.05 or CI excludes zero.
kevin: love it. also need to store a short history for baseline window (e.g., rolling 1h/24h) and allow user override.
aj: what about canary traffic low-sample early minutes? need min_samples and expose estimate variance in UI.
maria: deploy-bot: can someone from eng-sre review the alert routing? we want: if guard fires -> immediate canary traffic to baseline (auto rollback) for Dedicated & Private; for Hosted send alert to oncall and pause rollout.
deploy-bot: A deploy action is available via /rollout rollback <id> — audit event will be created.
sanjay: on alerting backend, I recommend we emit structured event: {rollout_id, guard_id, metric, delta_pct, baseline_count, canary_count, recommended_action}
kevin: question on evals: we should surface eval-set regressions alongside prod deltas. evals are less noisy for quality but don't capture infra regressions.
maria: UX: side-by-side tabs: "Prod delta" | "Eval results". Default to prod but link to eval run if exists.
zara: for the dashboard drilldown, add a link to traces + sample logs for top 5 error traces.
aj: can we add an API? e.g., GET /rollouts/{id}/metrics/deltas?window=5m&granularity=1m
maria: yes. backend will compute via difference of pre-aggregates, with fallback to sampled raw logs when needed.
sanjay: follow-ups: I'll draft the SQL for the delta computation and share.
kevin: i'll start a small prototype of the UI card and a mock JSON guard config.
maria: thanks — priority for next sprint. we should write acceptance criteria: 1) delta card + colored pill 2) guard config persisted + enforced 3) alert event schema 4) drilldown links to traces/logs 5) sample-size handling and stat test.
aj: tagging eng-sre and product for signoff. :thumbsup:

maria: OK closing — will post the design doc in #eng-platform/design after this thread.
